pccs_url_v3.description: PCCS server address for V3 API version. Used in commented default example.

pccs_url_v4.description: PCCS server address for V4 API version. Used in commented default example.

use_secure_cert.description: Whether to use secure HTTPS certificate. TRUE or FALSE.

tcb_update_type.description: TCB update type when PCCS is running in REQ mode. Options: STANDARD, EARLY, ALL.

user_token.description: User token required to access PCCS. Empty string if not used.

proxy_type.description: Proxy type. Options: direct, default, manual.

proxy_url.description: Proxy URL used when proxy_type is set to manual.
